create.name: Nicholas Pearson
create.bio:
Nicholas Pearson grew up collecting rocks and studied geology and mineral science at Stetson University in Florida, where he worked at the campus earth science museum and helped teach geology labs. He has spent around thirty years with crystals and minerals, and his writing sets the physical facts of each stone, its chemistry, structure and formation, beside the folklore, symbolism and spiritual uses that have gathered around it over centuries.

He is also a Reiki teacher who holds the title of shihan in the Japanese system of Usui Reiki Ryoho and takes a keen interest in where Reiki came from and how it changed as it travelled west. His books, mostly with Inner Traditions, include Crystal Basics, Stones of the Goddess, The Seven Archetypal Stones, Foundations of Reiki Ryoho and Flower Essences from the Witch's Garden. Based in Orlando, Florida, he teaches crystal and Reiki classes in person around the United States, runs livestream workshops for London's College of Psychic Studies, shares class replays through a Patreon membership and speaks at Omega and at magick and witchcraft festivals.

books.title: Crystal Basics: The Energetic, Healing, and Spiritual Power of 200 Gemstones
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: An illustrated handbook for working with crystals, from choosing, cleansing and programming stones to laying out grids. A directory profiles two hundred stones, pairing mineral facts with their traditional and spiritual uses.

books.title: Stones of the Goddess: 104 Crystals for the Divine Feminine
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: Over a hundred stones linked with goddesses and the sacred feminine, each explored through myth, folklore and mineralogy. Rituals, meditations and simple magick are included for working with them.

books.title: The Seven Archetypal Stones: Their Spiritual Powers and Teachings
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: Pearson treats seven stones, among them obsidian, jade, quartz and diamond, as teachers on the spiritual path. Each chapter brings together lore from many cultures, the science of the mineral and meditations for working with it.

books.title: Crystals for Karmic Healing: Transform Your Future by Releasing Your Past
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: A guide to using stones in work with karma, past lives and soul purpose. It covers more than fifty stones, along with fossils and amber, and gives exercises for cord cutting and for approaching the Akashic Records.

books.title: Foundations of Reiki Ryoho: A Manual of Shoden and Okuden
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: A full manual for the first two degrees of Usui Reiki Ryoho. It sets out hand positions, Japanese techniques, symbols and meditations, and traces how Reiki developed in Japan and later in the West.

books.title: Flower Essences from the Witch's Garden: Plant Spirits in Magickal Herbalism
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: An exploration of making and using flower essences from traditional witches' plants, including some poisonous ones that are safe only in essence form. Each plant is covered through its folklore, spirit and magickal uses.

books.title: Crystal Basics Pocket Encyclopedia: The Energetic, Healing, and Spiritual Power of 450 Gemstones
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: A compact, full-colour reference to 450 stones, each with a photograph, notes on its mineralogy and a short summary of its spiritual and energetic uses.

books.title: The Witching Stones: The Lore and Craft of the Essential Crystals, Gemstones, and Minerals to Empower Your Magic
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: A book for practising witches on the stones that matter most in folk magic, such as hagstones, flint and jet. It mixes history and lore with spells and hands-on craft.

books.title: Crystal Divination: The Multifaceted Art of Reading Stones
books.author: Devin Hunter, Nicholas Pearson
books.description: Written with Devin Hunter, this book surveys ways of divining with stones, from scrying and dowsing with pendulums to casting sets of stones and reading their patterns, with a guide to two hundred crystals.

courses.title: The Wisdom of Reiki Conference
courses.description: A weekend at Omega's Rhinebeck campus where several Reiki teachers share sessions, hands-on practice and talks on Reiki's history and spiritual side. Open to complete beginners as well as Reiki masters.
courses.price: Member $365 USD, standard $405 USD (tuition; accommodation extra)

courses.title: Reiki Shinpiden: Master/Teacher Training with Nicholas Pearson
courses.description: A three-day, in-person third-degree training for people who already hold first and second degree in any lineage. It covers the fourth symbol, how to give reiju and attunements, and advanced Japanese techniques, and leads to the title of shihan.

courses.title: Retrogrades in Astrology & Magic
courses.description: A four-hour livestream workshop for the College of Psychic Studies on what planetary retrogrades mean in astrology. Pearson suggests crystals, herbs, flower essences and simple magical practices for each one; a recording is provided.

courses.title: The Luminous Pearl on Patreon
courses.description: A monthly membership giving access to live sessions, replays of his mineral masterclasses, slides, book excerpts and unpublished writing on crystals, Reiki and flower essences.

flags: Crystal healing is his main subject; I kept books and talks that name no condition and left out Crystal Healing for the Heart (subtitle 'Gemstone Therapy for Physical ... Well-Being', with chapters on the physical heart).
Crystals for Psychic Self-Defense's blurb mentions countering 'geopathic stress' and 'EMF pollution'; not a medical claim or conspiracy content as written, kept: check you're happy with it.

Availability local_online with Orlando, Florida: his published mailing address is a PO box in Orlando and he teaches in person mostly in Florida, but he also travels to teach (Portland, New York). Change to worldwide if you prefer.
Shinpiden training: his own site lists it in Portland, Oregon, but the Eventbrite page says Vancouver, Washington (the same metro area); price read from the Eventbrite page.
Omega's Wisdom of Reiki Conference is shared with Llyn Roberts (rank 41) and William Lee Rand (plan exists).
Crystal Divination is co-written with Devin Hunter, and The Witching Stones carries a foreword by Hunter.
No own YouTube channel; all videos are talks or interviews on other channels where he is the main speaker.
TikTok count comes from the profile page's own data, not og:description; the total stays under 100k either way.
left_out: Crystal Healing for the Heart: borderline health framing (see flags).
